f.title: Retain full responsibility when subcontracting PV tasks
f.statement: Applicants/HCRs may subcontract PV activities to third parties with appropriate oversight and interface, excluding the QPPV role, but shall retain full responsibility for PSMF completeness and accuracy, fulfilment of all PV tasks and system quality and integrity, and an effective quality system for subcontracted tasks. Subcontractors may be inspected.
f.applicability: Medicines registered in South Africa (SAHPGL-CEM-PV-02 v2)

rows.actor: Applicant / holder of certificate of registration (HCR)
rows.quote: Applicants/HCRs may subcontract certain activities of the pharmacovigilance system to third-party organisations with appropriate oversight and interface, excluding the role of the QPPV. The applicant/HCR shall nevertheless retain full responsibility for: a) the completeness and accuracy of the PSMF. b) the fulfilment of all pharmacovigilance tasks and responsibilities and the quality and integrity of the pharmacovigilance system. c) ensuring that an effective quality system is applied in relation to the subcontracted tasks. 9.2 The subcontracted organisation may be subject to inspection at the discretion of the Authority.
rows.review_note: Review: quote extended through 9.1(a)-(c) and 9.2 so it proves the retained responsibilities and that subcontractors may be inspected. Double-check: confirmed: applicants/HCRs named; 'shall nevertheless retain full responsibility' with 'may subcontract' and inspection sentence in the quote.

f.title: Draw up PV subcontracts, describe them in the PSMF and list them in an annex
f.statement: When subcontracting tasks to another organisation, the applicant/HCR shall draw up subcontracts aimed at enabling compliance with the legal requirements by each party. A description of the subcontracted activities and/or services shall be included in the PSMF, and a list of the subcontracts, specifying the product(s) and territory(ies) concerned, shall be included in an annex to the PSMF.
f.applicability: Medicines registered in South Africa (SAHPGL-CEM-PV-02 v2)

rows.actor: Applicant / holder of certificate of registration (HCR)
rows.quote: When subcontracting tasks to another organisation, the applicant/HCR shall draw up subcontracts with the aim of enabling compliance with the legal requirements by each party involved. A description of the subcontracted activities and/or services shall be included in the PSMF and a list of the subcontracts shall be included in an annex to the PSMF, specifying the product(s) and territory(ies) concerned.
rows.review_note: Review: statement narrowed to the 'shall' duties the quote proves; the 'These contracts should' content (a)-(c), after a page footer, moved to new row 0102 as Recommended. Double-check: confirmed: 'shall' with applicant/HCR named; all three elements in the quote.

f.title: PV subcontracts: content and risk-based audits of the subcontractor
f.statement: PV subcontracts should be up to date and include sufficiently detailed descriptions of the delegated tasks, each party's responsibilities, related interactions and data exchange (e.g., agreed definitions, tools, assignments, timelines and regulatory reporting responsibilities); contain clear information on the practical management of PV and related processes, including maintenance of PV databases; and indicate the processes for checking ongoing adherence to the agreed arrangements, including regular risk-based audits of the other organisation by the applicant/HCR.
f.applicability: Medicines registered in South Africa (SAHPGL-CEM-PV-02 v2)

rows.actor: Applicant / holder of certificate of registration (HCR)
rows.quote: a) be up-to-date, include sufficiently detailed descriptions of the delegated tasks, the responsibilities of each party, the related interactions and data exchange, together with, for example, agreed definitions, tools, assignments, timelines and regulatory reporting responsibilities. b) contain clear information on the practical management of pharmacovigilance as well as related processes, including those for the maintenance of pharmacovigilance databases. c) indicate which processes are in place for checking whether the agreed arrangements are being adhered to on an ongoing basis. In this respect, regular risk-based audits of the other organisation by the applicant/ HCR.
